scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic. Exact polynomial identities and root isolation are replayed by a standard-library checker; numerical coordinates are used only as diagnostics and for comparison with the motivating source.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula is proved only for the normalized \(30^\circ\)-\(60^\circ\)-\(90^\circ\) triangle. It does not classify thermodynamic centers for arbitrary triangles. Unindexed earlier literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact algebraic coordinates of the \(30^\circ\)-\(60^\circ\)-\(90^\circ\) thermodynamic center
